meta.title: Forge Ember build plan
meta.decision: Direction A (Ember) from docs/designs/app-directions.html, chosen 2026-11-15: dark timeline Today, five dailies, one floating plus that opens a typed capture sheet, six labelled tabs kept. Design spec: docs/plan/ember/DESIGN.md.
meta.generated: Hand-authored; validate with node scripts/plan/plan-lint.mjs docs/plan/ember/plan.json

brief.rules: Defaults E1-E10 in docs/plan/ember/PLAN.md apply unless docs/adr/0005-ember-direction.md says otherwise. Use tokens, never colour literals. Do not touch supabase/ or sync v2 flags.

openDecisions.question: Which five things count as dailies?
openDecisions.default: Habits (all checked in), expenses logged, mood logged, code solved (goal 3), daily puzzle. Reminders and tasks do not count. Changeable in Settings.

openDecisions.question: What does a tap on plus open?
openDecisions.default: The capture sheet on the type that fits the screen (Expense on Money, Reminder on Reminders, Note on Notes, Solve on Logic), otherwise the last type used. All types are one chip away.

openDecisions.question: What happens to the nine Today tiles?
openDecisions.default: Tasks, Code, Spend and Mood tiles are replaced by the dailies and timeline. Streak, Wallet, Pets, Watch and Tutor stay below the timeline.

openDecisions.question: Does Ember replace the current themes?
openDecisions.default: No. Ember becomes the default for new installs; the seven existing themes stay selectable and your saved theme is kept.

openDecisions.question: Fonts: load Space Grotesk, Inter and JetBrains Mono, or stay on system fonts?
openDecisions.default: Self-host the three families (latin subset, under 160 kB) so the app works offline and matches the mockup.

openDecisions.question: Icons: keep emoji in the tab bar?
openDecisions.default: Tabs and controls use line icons. Category emoji and pets stay emoji.

openDecisions.question: Which new reminder features are in scope?
openDecisions.default: Snooze (1 hour, tonight 8 PM, tomorrow 9 AM), repeat (daily, weekly on chosen days, monthly) and one-tap reschedule for overdue items. Real alerts (push) stay in the main plan.

openDecisions.question: Does a day with no spending count as logged?
openDecisions.default: Yes, if you tap "Nothing spent today". Otherwise a day counts only when it has at least one entry.

openDecisions.question: What counts as the daily puzzle?
openDecisions.default: Any puzzle from the bank solved today, or the Lichess daily marked solved.

openDecisions.question: Widgets: build them now or after the web app ships?
openDecisions.default: After. Phase E5 starts only when you confirm a Mac with Xcode, an Apple Developer account and the iPhone shell from the main plan.

phases.name: Data and logic
phases.goal: Add everything the new screens need to know, as tested pure logic: the five dailies, puzzle solve dates, expense logging days, the Today timeline, reminder snooze and repeat, and the capture parser.
exit: npm test, lint and build green

exit: Today matches the mockup at 390px (differences listed in the gate report)

phases.name: Plus button and capture
phases.goal: One plus button on every tab that opens a capture sheet: type a sentence, check the chips, save. Covers expense, income, note, reminder, task, habit check-in, solve and mood.

N and the command palette open capture

phases.goal: Bring Life, Money, Logic, Invest, Agents and Settings to the Ember design, including reminders with snooze and repeat, notes with titles, and the expense logging strip.

phases.goal: Small, medium, large and lock-screen widgets fed by a snapshot from the app, with tick-off from the widget. Needs the iPhone app shell, a Mac and an Apple Developer account.
